description.text: Core courses University Mathematics, Measuring and Cartography, Natural Geography, Economic Geography, Basic Architecture, Principle of Environmentology, Architectural Drawing Reading and Graphics, Human Geography, Urban Geography, Western Economics, Management, Urban Planning, Geographical Information System, Urban Land Management, Real Estate Economics, Regional Analysis and Planning, Construction Projects--Quota and Budget, Investment Analysis of Real Estate, Law of Real Estate, Real Estate Finance, Real Estate Development and Management, Real Estate Price Assessment, Estate Management, Real Estate Marketing and Garden Planning and Design. Objective This objective is to train students to be high-quality professional personnel to work, after graduation, in scientific research institutions, colleges and universities or enterprises and administrative service departments; their occupation is related to research, teaching or administration affairs. The objective is also to train students to be able to work in real estate companies, financial institutions, colleges and universities, or land-affairs administration offices to be engaged in a variety of careers such as real estate investment, development, estate management, land business and administration. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Science is granted.

duration.text: The Resource Environment and Urban and Rural Planning Administration at Sichuan Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Certification of no criminal record 8.Copy of insurance policy 9.Photocopies of personal artwork Those who apply for artistic major should supply materials to prove your art level.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduates 2.No criminal record 3.HSK level 3 or above
